roles/iam.admin.title: IAM Admin
roles/iam.admin.desc: Full administrative access to all IAM resources

roles/iam.denyAdmin.title: Deny Admin
roles/iam.denyAdmin.desc: Deny admin role, with permissions to read and modify deny policies

roles/iam.denyReviewer.title: Deny Reviewer
roles/iam.denyReviewer.desc: Deny Reviewer role, with permissions to read deny policies

roles/iam.editor.title: IAM Editor
roles/iam.editor.desc: Write access to identity resources, with read access to all IAM resources

roles/iam.oauthClientAdmin.title: IAM OAuth Client Admin
roles/iam.oauthClientAdmin.desc: Full rights to create and manage OAuth clients.

roles/iam.oauthClientViewer.title: IAM OAuth Client Viewer
roles/iam.oauthClientViewer.desc: Read access to a particular instance of an OAuth client.

roles/iam.operationViewer.title: IAM Operation Viewer
roles/iam.operationViewer.desc: Operation user role, with permissions to view and list operations in IAM v3

roles/iam.organizationRoleAdmin.title: Organization Role Administrator
roles/iam.organizationRoleAdmin.desc: Provides access to administer all custom roles in the organization and the projects below it.

roles/iam.organizationRoleViewer.title: Organization Role Viewer
roles/iam.organizationRoleViewer.desc: Provides read access to all custom roles in the organization and the projects below it.

roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryAdmin.title: Principal Access Boundary Policy Admin
roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryAdmin.desc: Full management of Principal Access Boundary policies and their bindings to principal sets, including the ability to simulate policy impacts.

roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryUser.title: Principal Access Boundary Policy User
roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryUser.desc: View Principal Access Boundary policies and manage policy bindings to associate them with principal sets.

roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryViewer.title: Principal Access Boundary Policy Viewer
roles/iam.principalAccessBoundaryViewer.desc: Read-only access to Principal Access Boundary policies and their associated bindings.

roles/iam.roleAdmin.title: Role Administrator
roles/iam.roleAdmin.desc: Provides access to all custom roles in the project. This role can only be granted at the project level.

roles/iam.roleViewer.title: Role Viewer
roles/iam.roleViewer.desc: Provides read access to all custom roles in the project.

roles/iam.scimSyncer.title: SCIM Data Syncer
roles/iam.scimSyncer.desc: Rights to sync users and groups from external identity providers.

roles/iam.securityAdmin.title: Security Admin
roles/iam.securityAdmin.desc: Security admin role, with permissions to get and set any IAM policy.

roles/iam.securityReviewer.title: Security Reviewer
roles/iam.securityReviewer.desc: Provides permissions to list all resources and allow policies on them.

roles/iam.serviceAccountApiKeyBindingAdm.title: Service Account API Key Binding Admin
roles/iam.serviceAccountApiKeyBindingAdm.desc: Create and delete service account API Key bindings

roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin.title: Service Account Key Admin
roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin.desc: Create and manage (and rotate) service account keys.

roles/iam.serviceAccountOpenIdTokenCreat.title: Service Account OpenID Connect Identity Token Creator

roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator.title: Service Account Token Creator
roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator.desc: Impersonate service accounts (create OAuth2 access tokens, sign blobs or JWTs, etc).

roles/iam.serviceAccountUser.title: Service Account User
roles/iam.serviceAccountUser.desc: Run operations as the service account.

roles/iam.serviceAccountViewer.title: View Service Accounts
roles/iam.serviceAccountViewer.desc: Read access to service accounts, metadata, and keys.

roles/iam.viewer.title: IAM Viewer
roles/iam.viewer.desc: Read-only access to all IAM resources

roles/iam.workforcePoolAdmin.title: IAM Workforce Pool Admin
roles/iam.workforcePoolAdmin.desc: Full rights to create and manage all workforce pools in the org, along with the ability to delegate permissions to other admins.

roles/iam.workforcePoolEditor.title: IAM Workforce Pool Editor
roles/iam.workforcePoolEditor.desc: Gives permission to edit workforce pools.

roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser.title: Workload Identity User
roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser.desc: Impersonate service accounts from federated workloads.

roles/iam.workspacePoolAdmin.title: Workspace Pool IAM Admin
roles/iam.workspacePoolAdmin.desc: IAM workspace pool admin able to bind IAM policies to Dasher accounts.
